mission_07: Impressive! You have modeled a custom AI accelerator with systolic array architecture and benchmarked it against other designs using the roofline model. Your implementation shows how systolic arrays achieve high throughput through spatial parallelism: each PE operates simultaneously, and data flows through the array in a wavefront pattern. The roofline model reveals whether a workload is compute-bound (limited by MAC throughput) or memory-bound (limited by bandwidth), guiding architecture design decisions. Large matrix multiplications tend to be compute-bound on TPUs (many MAC units) but memory-bound on GPUs (limited bandwidth relative to compute). Understanding these trade-offs is essential for designing efficient AI hardware and optimizing models for specific accelerators.
